prelude: embedding times embedding_scale; low state starts from protected z_L_init
core: two physical H/L modules; each outer H cycle applies L three times then H once
loop_id: explicit outer H cycle 0..1; shared L scales receive three calls per outer cycle
protected: embedding, initial low state, untied head, norms, sigmoid attention gate and split-half FP32 rotary arithmetic
attention: bidirectional prefix and causal continuation with explicit per-row prefix lengths; padding excluded from keys
ce_kl_targets: first continuation token through last valid token; no prompt or padding loss
input_budget: all valid input tokens, including prefix; supervised targets reported separately
gradient: all H/L applications differentiated; does not reproduce author truncated-backprop training schedule
